result.brief: 提出 Khora 多智能体世界模型，将世界状态演化与视觉渲染解耦，通过共享世界状态与群体无关渲染接口实现推理时任意数量智能体的扩展，无需重训练，并支持实时交互式开放世界仿真。
result.reason: Proposes a multi-agent world model with shared world-state evolution and population-agnostic rendering, enabling inference-time scaling to arbitrary agent counts; directly matches video world models and interactive simulation.
